summary: Google I/O '26 keynote in which Sundar Pichai and other presenters announce Gemini 3.5, Omni, Antigravity 2.0, Gemini Spark, agents in Search, agentic shopping, creative tools, intelligent eyewear and AI-for-science work.

questions.question: In the Search information-agents segment, a phone lock screen shows a notification from a 'Biotech stocks task' agent. What time is displayed on that lock screen?
In the WeatherNext hurricane video near the end of the keynote, what name appears in the on-screen caption for the Google research scientist being interviewed?

While Demis talks about cybersecurity and says Google is inviting experts to test a new API for one of its tools, the slide shows three offerings. Besides the tool that gets the new API, which two offerings are on the slide?
questions.answer: Wiz (Cloud and AI Security) and Mandiant (Consulting)

questions.question: During the live audio-glasses demo, what tip percentage does Nishtha ask Gemini to add to her coffee order?
